description.original:
Need to automate PDF invoice and receipt processing?


I will build an n8n automation workflow to extract important information from PDF invoices and receipts and organize it automatically in Google Sheets.


What I can automate:

  • PDF invoice and receipt data extraction
  • Invoice number, date, vendor name and total amount
  • Automatic Google Sheets data entry
  • Basic data validation
  • Duplicate invoice checking (Premium package)
  • Email notifications (Premium package)


Why choose my service?

  • Customized n8n workflow
  • Organized and accurate data handling
  • Workflow testing before delivery
  • Clear setup instructions


I offer Basic, Standard and Premium packages to match your requirements.

Please contact me before ordering to discuss your PDF format, required fields and preferred integrations.


Note: Scanned PDFs may require an additional OCR service. Third-party API or subscription fees are not included.
